in_hebrew.name: תַּב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the root תָּבָה (tabh) meaning ‘mark, sign, engrave’. In the Bible, the name Tab is not found. However, it is similar in meaning to the Hebrew name Tav, which is the last letter of the Hebrew alphabet and symbolizes the covenant between God and His people.

in_greek.name: Ταπ
in_greek.long_meaning: There is no direct Greek equivalent for the name Tab. However, it is worth noting that the Greek word τάβος (tabos) means ‘grave, tomb’, which may be related to the meaning of the Hebrew name Tab as a mark or sign.

in_latin.name: Tab
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Tab is identical to its English counterpart and shares the same meaning as its Hebrew origin. However, it is not found in any Latin Christian texts or saints' names.
